physical.material: powder paint coated steel frame, plastic guides

base.description: The frame as XPU00 ships: empty, all eight slots open, the five guide posts in place.

lc-duplex-192.description: Eight 12-port LC duplex holders, the 192 fibres the datasheet gives as the most the frame holds. Illustrative.

mixed.description: One of each holder kind in each row: 12 LC duplex, 12 SC/APC, 6 LC duplex and 6 SC/APC. It shows the four slot fronts seated. Illustrative: holders are ordered separately from the frame.

xps00.description: XPS00 - the frame with grounding, as it ships: empty, all eight slots open. A copper-coloured grounding bar runs behind the posts; see provenance.grounding.

xpu00.description: XPU00 - the frame without grounding, as it ships: empty, all eight slots open.

datasheet.title: Fibrain patch panel HD without grounding, empty, datasheet XPU00 rev 2

description: HD patch panel frame, 1U, 19 in, 250 mm deep. An open steel frame with five plastic guide posts and eight slots, four across and two high. Each slot takes one HD slot part: an adapter holder, a cassette or a blind cover. Sold empty, as XPU00 without grounding and XPS00 with grounding.

gaps.note: the one drawing is named XPS00 and nothing separates what the grounded frame adds. The copper-coloured bar is read off one picture and is a mark on the plan only; the yellow label and the fasteners are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a square-on photograph of each of XPU00 and XPS00, or the parts list that says what XPS00 adds.

gaps.note: no rear, side or top CAD is published; the rear is the front mirrored and the plan is read off a datasheet drawing at 1.376 px/mm.
gaps.wanted: side and top views of XPS00 from the maker, whose CAD archive shows they exist.

gaps.note: the front elevation shows a slotted band 19 high at mid height behind the posts and nothing says how far back it stands. It is read as the upright of the rear cable bar and built there; it is not drawn on the front, where a slot mouth hides panel decor. See provenance.cross-member.
gaps.wanted: a side or top view of the frame, or a photograph from behind.

gaps.note: the front elevation and the datasheet front drawing both draw a floor sheet under the slot parts, 0.80 thick, and the datasheet plan an edge 30.5 to 52 behind the face that is read as its rear edge; the six renders of XPU00 show the posts hanging from the top sheet with no sheet under them. The drawings are followed and the floor is built.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the underside of either frame.

gaps.note: nothing numbers the slots; the order here is proposed, upper row first.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of a labelled, installed frame, or the numbering convention of the maker.

frame.description: the metal and plastic of the frame itself: two ears, five guide posts, the floor, the top sheet, the rear cable bar and two sides; on XPS00 the grounding bar.

slots.description: eight slots, four across and two high, each taking one HD slot part. Numbered left to right, the upper row first; the order is proposed, the frame prints none.

name: xpu

chassis.note: 484.60 wide over the ears and 43.96 high, off the drawing; 250 deep, off both datasheets (DSH-XPU00 rev 2, 15.05.2020, and DSH-XPS00 rev 1, 24.05.2020: height 1U, width 19 in, depth 250 mm, 1.2 kg). THE EARS ARE IN THE FACE: each is 24.70 wide and the frame between them 435.00, first post to last, so the front is drawn whole at 484.60 and no generic ear is added. The layers of the drawing name the ear as a rack bracket, a part of its own fixed to the frame side with pan-head screws; it is drawn as part of the face all the same, because the frame is not sold or shown without it.

cross-member.note: THE BAND BEHIND THE POSTS IS BUILT AS THE REAR CABLE BAR, AND IS NOT ON THE FRONT. Through the open slots the front elevation shows, on a part layer of its own, a slotted band 19.0 high, 12.5 to 31.5 from the top and so centred on the height, from 33.40 to 451.20, with a lip 1.2 thick top and bottom and twelve slots 20 x 4 on a 34.4 pitch at mid height, the first at 43.10. A front elevation says nothing of how far behind the face it stands. It cannot stand just behind the posts: the renders of XPU00, which look down through the slots, show nothing between the posts as far back as they see, about 65 at that height, and a cassette 169 deep fills each slot. The same renders show the rear cable bar as a stepped section with an upright, which from the front is such a band. So the band is read as that upright, and fibrain/xpu-cable-bar@1 builds it there, in the rear 29 of the frame; the reading is not a measurement. A CABLE DOES NOT RUN STRAIGHT BACK THROUGH IT: the upright stands across the middle 19 of the height, in line with the inner rows of a 12-way holder and with the one row of a 6-way, about 198 behind their backs, and a cable is dressed over or under the bar and tied to it. NOT DRAWN ON THE FRONT, where the maker draws it: a slot mouth is painted over the panel decor, so decor there is hidden in every configuration, and a part painted over a mouth is painted over a seated holder too. Nothing here can show a thing seen through an empty slot and covered by a seated part.

depth.note: everything behind the face other than the 250 overall: no side or top CAD is published. The side views draw a side wall as deep as the top sheet, an arm and the section of the rear bar. Heights are the front elevation's; how far each runs is estimated off the plan and the renders.

ears.note: fibrain/xpu-ear@1, one at each end, the right one turned half a turn; that part records the reading. The two round holes are 465.4 apart across the rack.

frame.note: a top sheet 0.80 thick at 0.05 to 0.85 and a floor 0.80 thick at 43.15 to 43.95, both 24.90 to 459.70; the front draws their edges.

grounding.note: WHAT GROUNDING CHANGES IS READ OFF TWO PICTURES. One drawing exists and it is named XPS00. Its layers name an M4 press-in stud at each ear junction, an M3 nut at the right one and pan-head screws at both, all edge-on slivers under 0.2 wide in a front elevation, and none is drawn. The product picture on the XPS00 datasheet shows a copper-coloured bar across the frame behind the posts and a round yellow label on the right side wall near the rear; the picture on the XPU00 datasheet, from the same viewpoint, shows no such bar and no label. So the XPS00 configuration alone carries fibrain/xpu-grounding-bar@1, a mark on the plan in a copper finish; it is not built, because nothing gives its section or where it stands. The label is not drawn. Which of the drawn fasteners XPU00 lacks, no document says.

lifecycle.note: searched 2026-10-12: a web search for XPU00 and XPS00 with the words end of sale, discontinued and end of life returned no notice from Fibrain, and both datasheets are on the HD panel page of the maker. Fibrain's own site was not searched page by page.

method.note: THE FRONT IS MEASURED ON THE ENTITIES OF A 1:1 FRONT ELEVATION. Fibrain publishes a CAD libraries archive (hd.fibrain.com/dxf/cad-libraries.zip, files dated 2020-07-30) holding XPS00.dxf: AutoCAD 2007, units millimetres, one front elevation with no dimension entities and no text. Its extents are 484.60 x 43.955. Every x here counts from the outer edge of the left ear and every y from the top of those extents. Gate 1: the 1U and 19 in of the datasheets against 43.96 and 484.60 (a rack face of 482.6 is 0.4 percent under the drawing). The plan is the line drawing on page 2 of both datasheets, one image in both, 782 px across at 1.376 px/mm: its 250 depth and its 435 body agree to 0.8 percent, so it is orthographic and coarse. Colour and construction are from the six vendor renders of XPU00 (XPU00_1 to _6, 2000 px, three-quarter views) and the product picture on each datasheet. THE DRAWING IS NAMED FOR XPS00 AND IS USED FOR BOTH: see `grounding`.

not-drawn.note: no mark or legend is drawn because none is seen: the renders show a plain black frame with nothing printed on its front, so no logo zone is reserved. The optional front cable manager (ORG-HD-1U-0) and the label fields (XL00) are separate parts and are not modelled here. The side labels the vendor animation shows on the ears are not drawn. A guide post is built only as its face, three millimetres proud.

numbering.note: PROPOSED, NOT THE MAKER'S. Nothing is printed on the frame and no document numbers its slots. Slots count left to right along the upper row, 1 to 4, then along the lower row, 5 to 8, which is the order the holders of this family count their own two rows and the order the 0.5U panel fibrain/xcu counts its one row.

plan.note: READ OFF THE DATASHEET PLAN AT 1.376 px/mm, so good to about a millimetre at best. Rear at y = 0. Each part of the top view records its own reading: the rear cable bar 29 deep, a stepped section with forty-eight tie slots counted, a side on each flank, the top sheet 90 deep across the middle and 115.6 at each end, the floor 30.5 and 52. The top sheet lies over the floor and the sides, and lifts off in a viewer to show them.

posts.note: five guide posts 7.01 wide on a 107.00 pitch, left edges 24.80, 131.80, 238.80, 345.80 and 452.80; fibrain/xpu-guide-post@1 records the post. The drawing puts the third to fifth posts 0.005 to 0.01 off that pitch, which is rounding in the file.

rear.note: NO REAR VIEW IS HELD. The rear is the front mirrored: the ears, the backs of the five posts, the edges of the top sheet and floor, the rear ends of the two arms that carry the rear cable bar, and one open passage behind each slot through which a seated holder shows its back. THE REAR CABLE BAR ITSELF IS NOT DRAWN HERE, though it is what stands nearest in this view: its upright would lie across the passages, over the backs the holders show there. The top and side views draw it, and it is built.

shell.note: AN OPEN SHEET BODY, NOT A BOX. The frame is a top sheet and a floor across the front, two sides, a bar across the rear and air between them, so the six views are elevations and the solid is built of the parts: the ears and posts on the front; the floor, the top sheet, the sides and the rear cable bar in the top view, where the floor is the well the others stand in. Cables pass through from the rear, over or under the rear cable bar, to the backs of the slot parts. 0.8 is the sheet the front elevation draws for the top sheet and for the floor.

slots.note: eight openings, each 99.99 wide between two posts and 21.00 high, the upper row 1.00 to 22.00 and the lower 22.00 to 43.00. A bay is the 100 x 21 envelope the holder datasheet states, centred on the opening, so it laps each post by 0.005.
